verdict.rationale: Anrok is API-first. It authenticates with a bearer API key, shows curl examples against REST endpoints such as transactions/createOrUpdate, and documents rate-limit handling with 429 and Retry-After. It also markets a "Headless Tax" product for running tax through APIs or agents, so it can be driven non-interactively from scripts or pipelines. Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK tooling for CI, CI/pipeline-specific guides or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation use.
